name: Javi López, Borja Giménez Larraz - § 5 - Am 18
title: INTERIM REPORT in view of the consent procedure on the Political, Economic and Cooperation Strategic Partnership Agreement between the EU and Mexico
part_text: 5. Highlights the importance of strengthening political dialogue and cooperation on global challenges while promoting stability, prosperity and mutual understanding between the two regions; stresses that this cooperation should be based on solidarity and mutual benefit; underlines that such relations should not be driven by further liberalisation, but by an alternative trade model that prioritises human rights, social justice and environmental sustainability, ensures policy space for public interest regulation, and supports fair and diversified economic development;
